name: Deep product research for our product
prompt: Do a product research for our product.com.np
expected_behavior: Checks for .agents/<productname>/product.md first
Researches the our product website, app stores, and social media
Produces a 13-section Product Research Brief
Includes Curriculum Board syllabus alignment as a key differentiator
Identifies pricing tiers (Free, Individual Subject, Bundle)
Lists [Local Payment Gateway] and [Local Payment Gateway] as payment methods
Covers all 5 target segments (Students, Teachers, Parents, School Leaders, Educators)
Mentions 7 international awards
Identifies positioning gaps (no public pricing page, weak social proof)

name: Quick scan with specific focus
prompt: Quick product research for our product target region, focus on pricing and user sentiment
expected_behavior: Performs a quick scan (not deep research)
Focuses specifically on pricing tiers and packaging
Highlights subject-based pricing model vs platform-based
Captures user sentiment from available reviews
Notes the lack of a public pricing page as a gap
Uses chatty, interactive approach — asks clarifying questions

name: Feature-to-benefit matrix
prompt: Build a feature-to-benefit matrix for our product target region's interactive video product
expected_behavior: Lists all core features (Interactive Videos, Testpaper, Classroom, Group Chat, Reports)
Maps each feature to user-facing benefits
Segments benefits by persona (Student, Teacher, Parent, School Leader)
Highlights dialogic pedagogy as the core differentiator
Mentions IVy and APollo proprietary technology

name: Product research without URL
expected_behavior: Checks .agents/<productname>/product.md for existing context
If found, uses it to identify the product as our product
If not found, asks for the product URL or recommends running product-marketing skill first
Does not hallucinate product details

name: Competitive positioning gap analysis
prompt: Identify positioning gaps for our product target region compared to free YouTube channels and Free Online Study Notes
expected_behavior: Researches both competitors (YouTube channels, Free Online Study Notes)
Identifies EduPlatform's advantages (interactive/dialogic format, testpapers, reports, Curriculum Board mapping)
Identifies EduPlatform's weaknesses relative to free alternatives (price barrier, limited social proof)
Provides actionable recommendations to close gaps
Follows iterative back-and-forth approach
